meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of DNAnexus platform capabilities verified against dxpy 0.410.0 and 2026 documentation baseline

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for DNAnexus cloud platform operations with clear security and cost control boundaries

methodological_ground.detail: Based on official DNAnexus SDK, CLI, and documented platform semantics with version-specific verification

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper security controls and error handling patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of DNAnexus operations including CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, workflows, with excellent reference organization and validation helpers

reliability.note: Excellent error prevention with validation scripts, safe preflight checks, explicit state verification, and comprehensive operations/troubleshooting reference

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (326 lines) with clear navigation table, 8 comprehensive reference files, and bundled validation/inspection helpers

agent_usability.note: Exceptional guidance with 'Choose the Right Path' decision table mapping goals to references; clear operating contract for safety-critical operations

human_usability.note: Clear installation with uv tool install; interactive login guidance; safe preflight checklist; Upload/Download Agent recommendations for scale

security.note: Outstanding security with explicit operating contract: credential protection rules, PHI/TRE respect, confirmation requirements, read-only first principle, and egress controls

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 2.0, clear license (MIT), 8 comprehensive references, 2 validation helpers, version baseline (2026-07-23), and authoritative source tracking

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools and explicit subprocess safety; job chaining pattern without polling; minor: could specify more output format schemas for API responses

key_strengths: Outstanding security posture with comprehensive 8-rule Operating Contract covering credential protection, PHI/TRE respect, cost controls, and read-only-first principle
Exceptional decision support with 'Choose the Right Path' table mapping user goals directly to appropriate reference documentation
Excellent safety engineering with Safe Preflight checklist, validation helpers, and explicit confirmation requirements for destructive operations
Strong version discipline with verified baseline (2026-07-23, dxpy 0.410.0) and authoritative source tracking in references/sources.md
Clear platform guidance on current best practices (Ubuntu 24.04, regionalOptions, dynamic instance selection) with deprecation warnings

recommendations.title: Add inline error recovery patterns for job chains
recommendations.problem: DXJobFailureError mentioned but error recovery workflow not demonstrated
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation focuses on happy path chaining without failure handling
recommendations.fix: Add example showing try/except with DXJobFailureError, re-describe for classification, and decision logic for retry vs abort in chained workflows

recommendations.title: Document cost limit enforcement behavior
recommendations.problem: --cost-limit parameter shown but what happens when limit is reached not explained
recommendations.root_cause: Parameter usage demonstrated without behavioral specification
recommendations.fix: Add note: 'Jobs exceeding --cost-limit are terminated with DXJobFailureError; set cost_limit higher than expected with headroom for retries'

recommendations.title: Expand validator capabilities documentation
recommendations.problem: validate_dxapp.py usage shown but what it checks not fully detailed in main doc
recommendations.root_cause: Helper script referenced without inline capability summary
recommendations.fix: Add brief list in main doc: 'Validator checks: deprecated runSpec placement, broad network access, missing regional requirements, retired instance types'
